impl Ledger {
    pub fn new(
        problem: &SolverProblem,
        tasks: Vec<Task>,
        quotas: Vec<u64>,
        budgets: Vec<u64>,
        capacities: Vec<u64>,
    ) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let num_nodes = problem.num_nodes;
        if capacities.len() != num_nodes { return Err("caps".into()); }
        let num_groups = quotas.len();
        if budgets.len() != num_groups { return Err("budgets".into()); }
        let num_tasks = tasks.len();
        let num_templates = problem.demands.len();
        let fp_words = (num_nodes + 63) / 64;

        // domain per node
        let mut node_domain = vec![-1i64; num_nodes];
        for (gi, members) in problem.source_merge_groups.iter().enumerate() {
            for &node in members {
                if node < num_nodes { node_domain[node] = gi as i64; }
            }
        }
        let mut tmpl_domain = Vec::with_capacity(num_templates);
        let mut tmpl_fp = vec![0u64; num_templates * fp_words];
        for (i, demand) in problem.demands.iter().enumerate() {
            let dom = match problem.demand_merge_classes.as_ref() {
                Some(classes) => *classes.get(i).unwrap_or(&0) as i64,
                None => node_domain[demand.src],
            };
            tmpl_domain.push(dom);
            let base = i * fp_words;
            for &node in &demand.footprint {
                if node < num_nodes {
                    tmpl_fp[base + node / 64] |= 1u64 << (node % 64);
                }
            }
        }
        ...
    }
}
